welcome.heading: Welcome
welcome.intro: Tools for figuring out the best way to spend your Banknotes in Last Asylum: Plague, computed live from manually harvested pack data.
welcome.analyzeDescription: Pick any item and see every package or exchange offer that yields it, ranked by cost per unit, plus the cheapest purchase plan to reach a target quantity.
welcome.compareDescription: Pick two items and quantities and compare how much value each provides, plus the cheapest purchase plan for each side by side.
welcome.rankingsDescription: Browse every package, exchange offer, and bonus tier ranked by how much value it returns relative to its price, to spot the best deals at a glance.
welcome.choicesDescription: Pick a choice chest or package and see which of its reward options is worth the most, ranked by the cheapest cost to buy that same reward elsewhere.
welcome.spendRewardsDescription: Pick a cumulative spend-reward event track and see each tier's marginal Banknote cost, value, and ratio — to spot the point where spending more stops paying off.
welcome.eventOffersDescription: Pick an event and see every shop offer's value against its actual Banknote cost, converted from the event currency using the same capacity-aware purchase logic as Analyze Item Value.

analyze.heading: Analyze Item Value
analyze.description: Pick an item, the amount you want, how many days you're planning to buy over, and (optionally) which purchase limits may be exceeded entirely. This shows every known purchase source for that item and the cheapest purchase plan to reach your target quantity.
analyze.sourcesEmpty: No purchasable sources found for this item.
analyze.sourcesFootnote: Exchange shop prices are converted to Banknotes using the cheapest known source for their currency item.
analyze.planEmpty: No purchasable sources found for this item.
analyze.planWarning: Warning: target quantity not fully reachable using known sources within purchase limits. Missing ~{remaining} unit(s).
analyze.detailsIntro: Shop packages needed to buy the {currency} currency for this row:

compare.heading: Compare Items
compare.description: Pick two items and how many of each you want, plus (optionally) active events, a planning horizon, and whether purchase limits may be exceeded. This shows which item provides more value for the quantity chosen, and the cheapest purchase plan for each side.
compare.valueDescription: Value is each item's bundle-aware fair Banknotes price (the same pricing the Value Ranking page uses) multiplied by its quantity.
compare.valuePrompt: Select both items above to compare their value.
compare.valueFallbackNote: No bundle-aware fair price known for: {items}. Showing a simplified cheapest-source estimate instead.
compare.valueUnknownNote: No known purchasable source at all for: {items}. Value shown as 0 for those.
compare.costDescription: Every known purchase source for each item, computed independently per item (same sources Analyze Item Value shows).
compare.planDescription: The cheapest purchase plan to reach each side's quantity, computed independently per item (same logic as Analyze Item Value).
compare.sidePrompt: Select an item above to see this.

rankings.heading: Value Ranking
rankings.description: Every package and shop exchange offer (including bonus tiers), ranked by how much value it provides relative to its price. Higher "Value Ratio" means a better deal. Click a row to see its full contents breakdown.
rankings.note: Value ratio = total value / price. Higher value ratio means more relative value for the Banknotes spent; entries marked incomplete contain at least one item with no known purchasable source, so total value is a lower-bound estimate.

choices.heading: Best Choice Pick
choices.description: Pick a choice chest or package (something that lets you select one or more rewards from a pool). Its options are ranked below by how much it would cost to buy that same reward elsewhere — the higher the value, the better the pick.
choices.optionsDescription: Each option is priced by what it would cost to buy that same reward through the cheapest other package or exchange offer. Ranked highest per-unit price first — that's the option worth picking.
choices.selectCountHintPartial: You can pick {count} of these {total} options — the top {count} above are the best picks.
choices.selectCountHintAll: You get all {total} of these options, so there's nothing to prioritize between them.
choices.optionsEmpty: This item has no choice options.

spendRewards.heading: Spend Rewards
spendRewards.description: Pick an event's cumulative spend-reward track. Each tier's cost is only the EXTRA Banknotes needed on top of the previous tier (not the full amount spent so far), so you can see the marginal value returned for spending further.
spendRewards.empty: No spend reward tracks defined yet.
spendRewards.selectPrompt: Select a reward track above to see its tiers.
spendRewards.note: Value ratio = tier value / step cost, where step cost is the extra Banknotes needed on top of the previous tier. Higher ratio means a better marginal deal; entries marked incomplete contain at least one item with no known purchasable source elsewhere, so value is a lower-bound estimate. Entries marked "Estimated" (only when the fallback checkbox above is enabled) priced at least one item using a rougher, non-bundle-fair estimate instead of leaving it unpriced — treat those values as a looser approximation.

eventOffers.heading: Event Offers
eventOffers.description: Pick an event to see every shop offer's value against what it actually costs in Banknotes, converted from the event currency via the cheapest still-available currency package(s) — Days / Exceed event limits below only control how much of that currency-SELLING capacity is available; an offer's own purchase limit (how much of it you can SPEND currency on) is never exceeded.
eventOffers.empty: No events with purchasable offers found.
eventOffers.selectPrompt: Select an event above to see its offers.
eventOffers.offersNote: Value ratio = offer value / Banknote cost. Higher ratio means a better deal. Cost is simulated independently per offer, as if it were the only thing bought today: the cheapest currency package covers it, using up its own purchase limit (within the selected Days / Exceed event limits) before falling back to a pricier one — "Unreachable" means the offer's currency can't be fully afforded within the chosen horizon even then. Max Ratio is the same calculation, but for buying this offer all the way up to its OWN purchase limit (over the selected Days — an offer's own limit is never exceeded, unlike the currency packages) instead of just once — a single small purchase often pays for a whole currency package it barely uses, so Max Ratio better reflects the offer's real value once that package's cost is spread over every purchase it actually affords; "N/A" means even the full purchase limit's currency need can't be fully afforded within the chosen horizon.
eventOffers.bonusTiersDescription: Cumulative currency milestones this shop also offers, priced the same way as the offers above but on their own separate currency budget. Step cost is only the EXTRA Banknotes needed on top of the previous tier.
